name_reason: Compliant. data_fd2_ prefix + battle domain (summon-spell battle animation, consistent with all companion variant-D/A/B/E summon symbols) + descriptor reflecting purpose (variant-D per-slot color index) and data type (array). The '4' is a genuine domain dimension, NOT a Ghidra address residue: Ghidra datatype is int[4] (DATALEN=16, 4 x i32) and the address ends in a7 not 4. The INIT loop seeds all 4 elements (for i in 0..3: color_idx[i]=i); the per-tick loop animates only the first 3 active slots (for i in 0..2). The '4slot' (storage dimension) vs '3slot' in the owner function name (active slots per tick) tension is intentional and accurate. Companion array at 0x54097 is named ..._4slot_frame_counter_array for the same reason.
purpose: Per-slot color-index array for the variant-D summon-spell animation; each entry holds the current per-color row-offset index (0..9) for its sprite slot, used to index the local copy of the per-color row-offset table when blitting.
logic_summary: BSS zero-init int[4] runtime scratch owned solely by fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot (@0x272B8, summon-spell tick dispatch-table entry #7). INIT (state_code 0) seeds color_idx[i] = i for i in 0..3 before any read this run. During TICK frames (state 2/5/8) only slots 0..2 are read: color = color_idx[i] is used as index into the local per-color row-offset table for the blit y position. On a frame-7 color rotation (and only when terminate_flag is clear), color_rotation_counter is advanced (counter++ % 10) and copied back into color_idx[i] for that slot. Values written are always 0..9 (slot index at init, then counter % 10), so element sign is immaterial.
element_semantics: int32 per-slot current color / per-color row-offset index, range 0..9. Index i = sprite slot (0..3 allocated; only 0..2 animated per tick). Element value indexes the 10-entry local per-color row-offset table.
notes: src comment block (anisummn.c lines 150-168) already accurate and precise: documents int[4] per-slot color index 0..9, init color_idx[i]=i, rotation store @0x27415, read @0x2744C used as table index, and that init seeds 4 slots while tick advances 3. Kept verbatim. Ghidra side stores its plate in PRE_COMMENT (PLATE_COMMENT is null): 'int[4] FD2 summon variant-D per-slot color index. Type: i32[4], Address: 0x540A7..0x540B6, Owner: fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot. Init: color_idx[i] = i; rotation: counter++%10 -> color_idx[i].' Consistent with src understanding (contains a non-ASCII arrow but that is the Ghidra-side plate, exempt from the src ASCII-only rule); not contradictory/stale/blank, so left untouched per 'consistent = leave plate alone'. is_const=false: game-side WRITE xrefs at 0x27326 (init) and 0x27415 (rotation), plus READ at 0x2744C -> mutable runtime scratch, correctly declared non-const in src. No logic changes made (refine-only).
